label: Predictable grammatical continuations
explanation: Fires on tokens that are highly predictable completions of the local syntactic/collocational context, especially function words, punctuation, and the second element of common bigrams (e.g., "leads to", "day or", "night of", "byte and"). Fires most strongly when the continuation is tightly constrained by the preceding words (e.g., "dollar" after "$5000", "to" after "leads"), and stays silent on unpredictable/content-heavy tokens and at sequence starts.
